support_validation.scope: actual material connectivity and finite-volume separation only; no force/stiffness/pressure qualification

support_mass.method: importance sample actual wall volumes; unique volume = gross * mean(1/multiplicity)

support_mass_coarse.method: importance sample actual wall volumes; unique volume = gross * mean(1/multiplicity)
support_mass_coarse.scope: frame/feet stock only; no case, cold magnet or chamber mass; no strength qualification

coverage.scope: 4pi, both ends, all phi; equal-solid-angle midpoint quadrature

without_support_repacking.scope: counterfactual whole-panel repacking without frame; includes segmentation changes, not a material veto

support_shadows.scope: actual hollow support walls; not a reconstruction veto

coarse_coverage.scope: 4pi, both ends, all phi; equal-solid-angle midpoint quadrature

without_support_repacking.scope: counterfactual whole-panel repacking without frame; includes segmentation changes, not a material veto

support_shadows.scope: actual hollow support walls; not a reconstruction veto

sampling.interpretation: deterministic grid sensitivity, not statistical error or a convergence proof

independent_integration.method: iid uniform cos(theta),phi; independent of image grid

without_support_repacking.scope: whole-panel repacking control; includes segmentation changes, not support material veto

independent_integration.scope: binomial standard errors describe integration sampling only; geometry uncertainty excluded

analytic_beam_opening.scope: two polar cones through nominal first-disk bore; additional coil/module gaps separate

limits: geometric straight IP rays, no detector response, scattering or efficiency

support connectivity and self-mass do not certify strength, stiffness or energized forces

mu_r=1 support proxies preserve pinned vacuum field; installed HCAL/steel solution absent
no MDT internal geometry, chamber masses, electronics, services or chamber mounts
support unique union mass has Monte Carlo sampling error; material/dimension uncertainty unquantified
